description: Defines a sealed class 'GuidId' that provides a unique, immutable identifier based on Guid with methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and interning cache logic.

classes.name: GuidId
classes.description: A sealed class representing a unique identifier based on Guid, implementing comparison, equality, serialization, and interning.

methods.name: GetNewGuidId
methods.description: Returns a new, randomly generated GuidId.

methods.name: GetGuidId
methods.description: Returns a GuidId instance corresponding to the provided Guid.

methods.name: FindOrCreateGuidId
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create a GuidId instance from the interner cache.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this GuidId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the underlying Guid.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the Guid.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Serializes the GuidId for storage or transmission.
